title: [Panel Edit Mode] "Miniature desktop" header buttons overlap each other when screen space is limited or large scaling is used when locale has long words
line: With the panel settings open, the buttons above the small desktop preview no longer overlap: when their labels don't fit they all become icons with tooltips.
explanation: When the panel settings are open, the desktop is zoomed out into a small preview beside them, and with large scaling, a big font and long translations (German) it is only a few hundred pixels wide. Its toolbar is a Flow of buttons (Add Widgets, Add Panel, Manage Desktops) next to the More (touch mode only) and Exit Edit Mode buttons, all of which always kept their full text, so Exit Edit Mode was drawn over the first button and the others ran out of the preview under the dialog; in normal edit mode the same setup wrapped the toolbar into rows that went off the top of the screen. The change gives the toolbar a single compact mode: when the full-text width of all visible buttons (including More) plus spacing doesn't fit, every button switches to icon-only with a tooltip carrying its label. That width is computed from each button's padding, icon, spacing and a TextMetrics of its label, so it doesn't depend on the mode it decides.

commits.message:
desktoppackage: show only icons in edit mode toolbar when it's too narrow

Next to the panel settings the zoomed-out desktop can be very narrow,
and its toolbar buttons kept their full text, so they were drawn on top
of each other. Now they all show only their icons with tooltips then.

BUG: 527108

patches.diff:
From 1c4db9b305593a9d3512aa3445bc808b45d03884 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 00:31:10 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: show only icons in edit mode toolbar when
 it's too narrow

Next to the panel settings the zoomed-out desktop can be very narrow,
and its toolbar buttons kept their full text, so they were drawn on top
of each other. Now they all show only their icons with tooltips then.

BUG: 527108
---
 .../contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml        | 42 ++++++++++++++++---
 1 file changed, 37 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
index fd643d976f..61180055c5 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/views/DesktopEditMode.qml
@@ -17,6 +17,26 @@ import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
 
 Item {
     id: editModeItem
+
+    component ToolBarButton: PC.ToolButton {
+        id: toolBarButton
+
+        property bool compact: false
+        // How wide the button is with its text, even while only its icon is shown
+        readonly property real fullWidth: leftPadding + rightPadding + Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium + spacing + Math.ceil(textMetrics.advanceWidth)
+            + (Accessible.role === Accessible.ButtonMenu ? spacing + Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small : 0)
+
+        display: compact ? PC.AbstractButton.IconOnly : PC.AbstractButton.TextBesideIcon
+        PC.ToolTip.text: text
+        PC.ToolTip.visible: compact && hovered
+        PC.ToolTip.delay: Kirigami.Units.toolTipDelay
+
+        TextMetrics {
+            id: textMetrics
+            font: toolBarButton.font
+            text: toolBarButton.Kirigami.MnemonicData.plainTextLabel
+        }
+    }
     property real centerX: Math.round(editModeUi.x + editModeUi.width/2)
     property real centerY: Math.round(editModeUi.y + editModeUi.height/2)
     property real roundedRootWidth: Math.round(root.width)
@@ -88,6 +108,11 @@ Item {
                 LayoutMirroring.enabled: Application.layoutDirection === Qt.RightToLeft
                 LayoutMirroring.childrenInherit: true
                 spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                // Show only the icons when the buttons don't fit with their text, e.g. on the
+                // small zoomed-out desktop next to the panel configuration dialog
+                readonly property bool compact: width < [addWidgetButton, addPanelButton, manageContainmentsButton, moreButton, exitButton]
+                    .filter(button => button.visible)
+                    .reduce((total, button, index) => total + (index > 0 ? spacing : 0) + button.fullWidth, 0)
                 anchors {
                     left: parent.left
                     top: parent.top
@@ -98,16 +123,18 @@ Item {
                     Layout.fillWidth: true
                     Layout.minimumHeight: implicitHeight
                     spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
-                    PC.ToolButton {
+                    ToolBarButton {
                         id: addWidgetButton
+                        compact: toolBar.compact
                         property QtObject qAction: containment?.plasmoid.internalAction("add widgets") || null
                         text: qAction?.text
                         icon.name: "view-group-symbolic"
                         onClicked: qAction.trigger()
                     }
 
-                    PC.ToolButton {
+                    ToolBarButton {
                         id: addPanelButton
+                        compact: toolBar.compact
                         height: addWidgetButton.height
                         property QtObject qAction: containment?.plasmoid.corona.action("add panel") || null
                         text: qAction?.text
@@ -116,8 +143,9 @@ Item {
                         onClicked: containment.plasmoid.corona.showAddPanelContextMenu(mapToGlobal(0, height))
                     }
 
-                    PC.ToolButton {
+                    ToolBarButton {
                         id: manageContainmentsButton
+                        compact: toolBar.compact
                         property QtObject qAction: containment?.plasmoid.corona.action("manage-containments") || null
                         text: qAction?.text
                         visible: qAction?.visible || false
@@ -126,8 +154,10 @@ Item {
                     }
                 }
 
-                PC.ToolButton {
+                ToolBarButton {
+                    id: moreButton
                     Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
+                    compact: toolBar.compact
 
                     visible: Kirigami.Settings.hasTransientTouchInput || Kirigami.Settings.tabletMode
 
@@ -138,8 +168,10 @@ Item {
                         containment.openContextMenu(mapToGlobal(0, height));
                     }
                 }
-                PC.ToolButton {
+                ToolBarButton {
+                    id: exitButton
                     Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
+                    compact: toolBar.compact
                     icon.name: "dialog-ok-symbolic"
                     text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Exit Edit Mode")
                     onClicked: containment.plasmoid.corona.editMode = false
--

review.text: Fixes the overlapping edit-mode toolbar buttons cleanly in DesktopEditMode.qml by introducing an inline ToolBarButton component that computes its full-text width via TextMetrics (avoiding binding loops) and switching all visible toolbar buttons to IconOnly with tooltips whenever the toolbar is too narrow. Also resolves the normal edit-mode vertical wrap overflow with long translations and large fonts, while keeping full labels when space permits. Thoroughly verified across German 150%/15pt, touch mode, tooltips, and default English 100%.
